messages:
elaine: Hey team — PR #4823 is ready for docs review but Netlify preview is showing missing images and a 404 on hashed asset files. Can someone take a quick look?

sam: I tried the preview just now — build completed but there are 404s for `/assets/site/icons-abc123.svg` and a few fonts. Netlify log shows: 
```
11:34:02 AM: Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat 'site/assets/site/icons-abc123.svg'
11:34:02 AM: Did not copy: assets/site/icons-abc123.svg
```
Seems like assets are being emitted to `site/assets` but our docs references expect `/assets/site/...` (double nest).

mohit: That rings a bell — we changed the mkdocs `site_dir` in an earlier PR and some relative paths got broken. Quick fix is to update the docs link to use `{{ base_url }}/assets/...` or set `site_dir: site` consistently. But long-term we should avoid absolute `/assets` references in the templates.

elaine: Ugh. The PR is mainly SDK snippet updates, so I don't want to rework the whole template. Can we do a small change to the asset references in this PR and merge?

junie: Also flagging merge time — staging has a heavy Netlify queue between 11:00-12:00 PT. If we merge after 12:15 PT the preview should build faster. Can we aim for 12:30? :calendar: 

sam: I can take the quick fix (two lines). Will push a tiny commit to replace `/assets/site/` -> `assets/site/` (relative) in the affected includes. That should match how `site` is published.

mohit: For SDK snippets, heads-up: python example uses `from redwood import Client` but our package name landed as `redwood_inference` in pip. Please add both variants in the snippet with a short note, e.g.:
```
# pip install redwood-inference
from redwood_inference import Client  # or: from redwood import Client (compat shim)
```

elaine: Great — can you also add a tiny local preview note in the PR description for reviewers who want to run it? People often ask.

sam: Doing that. Will add a short "Local preview" section: 
- `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt`
- `mkdocs build -d site`
- `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000`  (or `python -m http.server --directory site 8000`)
And a note: if assets look wrong, run `mkdocs build` then open `site/index.html` locally.

elaine: Awesome. CI bot? Any blockers on the docs tests?

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview build failed on branch fix/asset-path — 1 failing check: `linkcheck` (404 on /assets/site/icons-abc123.svg). Full log: https://ci.redwood/internal/ci/1935550000/build/12

sam: I'll push the asset patch now and re-trigger the Netlify preview. If Netlify still shows an old artifact, we can force a rebuild in the Netlify UI (Top menu -> Deploys -> Trigger deploy).

junie: After your push, let's wait until 12:35 PT and merge if preview looks good. Assigning reviews: @sam and @mohit for technical content, @elaine for wording; hoping for a quick one-click. :thumbsup: 

elaine: Thanks — noted. I'll update the PR description with the local preview snippet and the SDK install note. If anyone hits the local build oddity, mention `mkdocs-material` version pin (we're on 9.1.7). Older/newer versions can change asset paths.

sam: Patch pushed: replaced absolute asset refs, added Local preview section, added compatibility note for python import. Triggering Netlify rebuild now.

ci-bot: Netlify preview started: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.ai (status page updates in ~2min)

mohit: Quick review LGTM on snippets. One nit: change `Client(api_key=...)` example to use `client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")` so people don't paste literal keys.

elaine: Nice catch. I'll add that change if you don't.

sam: Done. Updated snippet.

elaine: Let's reconvene at 12:35 PT to merge if preview is green. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
